result.summary: Found 1 layout issue where a restaurant title is prematurely clipped despite having ample available horizontal space.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' has its final letter clipped ('Tokumaru Rameı'), even though there is plenty of empty space between the title and the rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Increase the width or flex-grow constraint of the title text container so the full restaurant name can be displayed without premature clipping, or use proper text-overflow ellipsis only when space actually runs out.
